original_claim: Model weights and centroids were modified between Phase 4D-B and 4D-C based on differing reported hashes.
audit_finding: FALSE. Checkpoint bytes in Git commit 490a429 and b0ee639, Phase 4B audit, Phase 4D-B feasibility audit, Phase 4D-C manifests, and current disk are 100% byte-identical.
corrected_claim: Core model checkpoint (9c0a5a09...) and centroids (2ea33ac1...) have been strictly frozen and unchanged since creation. Differing hashes in Phase 4D-B were documentation typos.

original_claim: Phase 4D-C represents an immutable, pre-registered sealed test evaluation.
audit_finding: UNVERIFIED. Protocol file and hash manifest were programmatically co-generated with or after test evaluation pass at 18:58 UTC. Configuration was frozen, but test was not pre-registered in advance.
corrected_claim: Phase 4D-C constitutes an exploratory source-disjoint pilot with frozen baseline configurations, not a pre-registered confirmatory trial.

original_claim: The dataset contains 32 parents: 19 development, 7 validation, 5 test (sum = 31).
audit_finding: NARRATIVE_TYPO. Authoritative source manifests contain exactly 18 development, 9 validation, and 5 test parents across 15 families (sum = 32). Invariants verified 100% disjoint.
corrected_claim: Authoritative partition breakdown is 18 development (9 families), 9 validation (3 families), and 5 sealed test (3 families), totaling exactly 32 parents (15 families).

original_claim: SEC EDGAR exhibit contracts are automatic public domain works under 17 U.S.C. Section 105.
audit_finding: LEGAL_ERROR. 17 U.S.C. Section 105 applies only to works of the U.S. Government. Privately drafted commercial contracts filed with the SEC remain privately authored.
corrected_claim: EDGAR exhibits are publicly accessible corporate filings with rights undetermined (fair use permitted for internal research). Complete text should not be redistributed.

original_claim: Phase 4D-C positive cases mechanically broke backward discourse referents between clauses.
audit_finding: DEFECTIVE_ASSUMPTION. Target backward discourse markers ('the foregoing definition', 'the preceding sentence') reside internally within multi-sentence clauses. Swapping clauses did not displace the antecedent.
corrected_claim: Discourse perturbation engine inverted section blocks with intra-clause antecedents. P1 cases lack broken discourse dependencies; held-out test positive sample size is N=2 (both from single parent).

original_claim: Candidate C3 achieves superior generalizable structural coherence detection over production baselines.
audit_finding: UNSUPPORTED_OVERCLAIM. Candidate C3 specificity is 31.25% (5/16) and F1 is 0.27 on 18 test cases; sensitivity analysis with corrected labels shows metrics drop to 0.15 F1 or NOT_ESTIMABLE.
corrected_claim: All models exhibit high false positive rates (>68%) on independent commercial contracts. Statistical power is insufficient for definitive ranking; further research is needed.

original_claim: Candidate C2 either universally detects anomalies (100% recall) or universally underfits (0% recall) without distinction.
audit_finding: DIVERGENCE_EXPLAINED. In raw predictions, uncalibrated sigmoid scores (~0.523) exceeded 0.50 threshold, yielding TP=2, FP=16. Narrative reports published intended underfitting (TP=0, FP=0, FN=2, TN=16).
corrected_claim: Both derivations reconciled: raw thresholding yields TP=2, FP=16, FN=0, TN=0; canonical historical reporting underfitting yields TP=0, FP=0, FN=2, TN=16 with NOT_ESTIMABLE precision and F1.

original_claim: SEC EDGAR inventory consists of 10 filings and historical regression baseline is 183 tests.
audit_finding: CONFLATION_RESOLVED. 10 refers to top-level dictionary keys in edgar_manifest.json, not filings. Manifest contains 50 exhibit entries across 19 accessions and 19 CIKs. Raw pytest log in Phase 4D-C proves 193 passed (185 to 195 collected).
corrected_claim: Authoritative SEC inventory is 50 entries, 19 accessions, 19 CIKs, 50 files, 32 eligible parents. Authoritative Phase 4D-C regression count is 193 passed, 2 skipped.
